001package zemeckis;
002
003import static org.realityforge.braincheck.Guards.*;
004
005import grim.annotations.OmitClinit;
006import grim.annotations.OmitSymbol;
007import java.util.Objects;
008import org.jetbrains.annotations.TestOnly;
009import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
010
011/**
012 * Processing unit responsible for executing tasks.
013 */
014@OmitClinit
015public final class VirtualProcessorUnit {
016    /**
017     * A human consumable name for node. It should be non-null if {@link Zemeckis#areNamesEnabled()} returns
018     * true and <tt>null</tt> otherwise.
019     */
020    @OmitSymbol(unless = "zemeckis.enable_names")
021    @Nullable
022    private final String _name;
023    /**
024     * The executor responsible for selecting and invoking tasks.
025     */
026    private final Executor _executor;
027
028    /**
029     * Create the processor unit.
030     *
031     * @param executor the associated task executor.
032     */
033    VirtualProcessorUnit(@Nullable final String name, final Executor executor) {
034        if (Zemeckis.shouldCheckApiInvariants()) {
035            apiInvariant(
036                    () -> Zemeckis.areNamesEnabled() || null == name,
037                    () -> "Zemeckis-0002: VirtualProcessorUnit passed a name '" + name + "' but "
038                            + "Zemeckis.areNamesEnabled() is false");
039        }
040        _name = Zemeckis.areNamesEnabled() ? Objects.requireNonNull(name) : null;
041        _executor = Objects.requireNonNull(executor);
042        _executor.init(activationFn -> VirtualProcessorUnitsHolder.activate(this, activationFn));
043    }
044
045    /**
046     * Return the name of the VirtualProcessorUnit.
047     * This method should NOT be invoked unless {@link Zemeckis#areNamesEnabled()} returns true and will throw an
048     * exception if invariant checking is enabled.
049     *
050     * @return the name of the VirtualProcessorUnit.
051     */
052    @OmitSymbol(unless = "zemeckis.enable_names")
053    public String getName() {
054        if (Zemeckis.shouldCheckApiInvariants()) {
055            apiInvariant(
056                    Zemeckis::areNamesEnabled,
057                    () -> "Zemeckis-0003: VirtualProcessorUnit.getName() invoked when Zemeckis.areNamesEnabled() is"
058                            + " false");
059        }
060        return Objects.requireNonNull(_name);
061    }
062
063    /**
064     * Queue task for execution and enable the executor for activation if necessary.
065     * The task must not be already queued.
066     *
067     * @param name A human consumable name for the task. It should be non-null if {@link Zemeckis#areNamesEnabled()} returns true and <code>null</code> otherwise.
068     * @param task the task.
069     * @return the {@link Cancelable} instance that can be used to cancel execution of the task.
070     */
071    public Cancelable queue(@Nullable final String name, final Runnable task) {
072        return getExecutor().queue(name, task);
073    }
074
075    Executor getExecutor() {
076        return _executor;
077    }
078
079    @OmitSymbol(unless = "zemeckis.enable_names")
080    @Override
081    public String toString() {
082        return Zemeckis.areNamesEnabled() ? getName() : super.toString();
083    }
084
085    /**
086     * Interface via which the {@link VirtualProcessorUnit} executes tasks.
087     * The executor is responsible for activating the underlying {@link VirtualProcessorUnit} when required.
088     * Each time the {@link VirtualProcessorUnit} is activated it will use callback to talk to executor
089     * and the executor is responsible for selecting and executing tasks until it decides to return control
090     * to the {@link VirtualProcessorUnit}.
091     */
092    interface Executor {
093        /**
094         * Initialize the executor passing in the context associated with the underlying {@link VirtualProcessorUnit}.
095         *
096         * @param context the context represent the associated {@link VirtualProcessorUnit}.
097         */
098        void init(Context context);
099
100        /**
101         * Reset state of executor.
102         * This is only used from within the test framework.
103         */
104        @TestOnly
105        void reset();
106
107        /**
108         * Queue task for execution and enable the executor for activation if necessary.
109         * The task must not be already queued.
110         *
111         * @param name A human consumable name for the task. It should be non-null if {@link Zemeckis#areNamesEnabled()} returns true and <tt>null</tt> otherwise.
112         * @param task the task.
113         * @return the {@link Cancelable} instance that can be used to cancel execution of the task.
114         */
115        Cancelable queue(@Nullable String name, Runnable task);
116
117        /**
118         * Queue task for execution next. The executor is not activated. The task must not be already queued.
119         *
120         * @param task the task.
121         */
122        void queueNext(@Nullable final String name, Runnable task);
123
124        /**
125         * Activate the executor.
126         */
127        void activate();
128    }
129
130    @FunctionalInterface
131    interface ActivationFn {
132        /**
133         * Callback method invoked by {@link Context#activate(ActivationFn)} to process tasks.
134         */
135        void invoke();
136    }
137
138    /**
139     * Interface representing {@link VirtualProcessorUnit} passed to {@link Executor} during initialization.
140     * This interface is designed to allow the {@link Executor} to activate the {@link VirtualProcessorUnit}
141     * when it needs to execute tasks.
142     */
143    interface Context {
144        /**
145         * Activate the associated {@link VirtualProcessorUnit}.
146         * This method MUST only be called if there is no {@link VirtualProcessorUnit} unit currently activated.
147         * The activation will set the "current" VPU for the duration of the activation and invoke the
148         * {@link ActivationFn#invoke()} function passed into the method.
149         *
150         * @param activationFn the function passed to process tasks.
151         */
152        void activate(ActivationFn activationFn);
153    }
154}
